cards.subject: The GG Money application
says: is an in-house bookkeeping, VAT and payroll application
files directly to HMRC
was built to replace a QuickBooks subscription
cards.use: need the system that keeps the books for Gurugraphics Limited and Moksy Limited
not: is sold as a service to any UK company that signs up

cards.subject: The GG Money user base
says: is two limited companies, Gurugraphics Limited and Moksy Limited
has one owner according to the 5 October 2026 roadmap
is described in that roadmap as not multi-tenant
cards.use: are asked who the application is built for
not: is open to any customer who registers

cards.subject: The live site
says: is served at ggmoney.gglink.co.uk
runs on the existing Apache VPS
sits behind Cloudflare
cards.use: need to say where the application is hosted
not: runs on a new dedicated cloud platform built for it

cards.subject: Sandbox mode
says: means nothing has yet been filed for real through the live install
is selected through APP_ENV
stays until production credentials exist and a parallel run has matched
cards.use: hear that the live install files real returns today
not: lets the live install file real VAT returns while credentials are pending

cards.subject: Corporation Tax filing
says: is marked not built and left to a later phase
includes the CT600 and iXBRL accounts in that gap
leaves year-end accounts to an accountant or a filing tool for now
cards.use: are asked which major filing the application cannot yet do
not: is fully built and tested alongside VAT

cards.subject: Self Assessment under MTD ITSA
says: has a personal profile, HMRC-box costs, quarterly update preparation and a tax calculator
has no connected HMRC API submission yet
concerns sole traders and landlords rather than the limited companies
cards.use: need to know why quarterly income-tax updates cannot yet be sent from the app
not: is filed directly to HMRC once the quarterly update is prepared

cards.subject: The README status table
says: lists each area as working, needing credentials or not built
marks Open Banking feeds as working but needing provider credentials
marks VAT submission as working but needing HMRC credentials
cards.use: want the first source for what is built
not: is generated from the compliance task list

cards.subject: The 5 October 2026 roadmap
says: adds caveats to items the README marks working
says nothing in the web layer calls the FPS and EPS builders
says there is no EPS builder and credit notes are missing
cards.use: need a more cautious view than the README status table
not: confirms every working item in the README as production ready

cards.subject: Phase 0 of the roadmap
says: is called trust
begins with tenant isolation, bank CSV import bugs and VAT and payroll finalise issues
ends with all tests re-run on MySQL as well as SQLite
cards.use: are asked what must be fixed before anything else is built
not: is the phase that builds Corporation Tax and the CT600

cards.subject: The no-dependency rule
says: means the app uses no Composer, no npm and no third-party packages
requires PHP 8.1 or later
leaves the application as plain PHP plus a database
cards.use: need to explain why the project has no package manager files
not: pulls the HTTP client from Composer

cards.subject: SQLite
says: is the default for local development and the test suite
stores money in 64-bit INTEGER columns
is backed up with VACUUM INTO
cards.use: want the database used by the test suite
not: is the database the live server uses

cards.subject: MySQL
says: is what the live server uses
uses BIGINT money columns because INT overflows at 21.5 million pounds
runs in STRICT sql_mode so a truncated money value errors
was chosen because MySQL 8 and a PHP 8.1 driver were already installed
cards.use: need the database behind the live site
not: is used only for local development

cards.subject: The migrations directory
says: keeps a separate schema for each database driver
avoids translating SQL at run time
tracks applied migrations in schema_migrations
cards.use: wonder why schema files are duplicated for two databases
not: translates MySQL statements to SQLite on the fly

cards.subject: PHP 8.1 FPM
says: runs GG Money alone while other sites stay on mod_php 7.4
is chosen per virtual host
receives .php requests through a handler on a Unix socket
cards.use: need to explain how one site runs a newer PHP than the rest of the server
not: replaces mod_php 7.4 for every site on the server

cards.subject: config.local.php
says: holds the secrets and overrides the defaults in config.php
is gitignored
is never touched by the deploy script
cards.use: need to know where database passwords and API keys live
not: is committed to the repository with the code

cards.subject: Cloudflare
says: sits in front of the origin server
must be set to Full (strict) for this hostname
would send HMRC tokens in the clear to the origin in Flexible mode
cards.use: need to explain a required SSL mode for the hostname
not: is bypassed entirely so requests reach the origin directly

cards.subject: Integer pence
says: stores every monetary value as a whole number of pence
bans floats for money everywhere in the app
makes 480000 stand for £4,800.00 in the API
cards.use: need to know how an amount is held in the database
not: stores amounts as decimal pounds with two places

cards.subject: A basis point
says: is one hundredth of a percentage point
turns 20 percent into the integer 2000
lets rates be stored without floating point
cards.use: need to store a percentage as a whole number
not: turns 20 percent into the integer 20

cards.subject: Core\Money
says: is the only place where money conversion happens
converts between pounds and pence
was found by the 4 October stress run to misread typed amounts such as 1e3
cards.use: need the single class that converts money
not: is called by each controller to run its own parsing

cards.subject: A posted journal
says: is never edited or deleted once posted
keeps the ledger history intact even after a bad code deploy
cards.use: are asked whether a posted entry can be changed
not: can be edited by an accountant until the month closes

cards.subject: A reversal
says: is a new journal that offsets an earlier one
leaves both the error and the fix visible
is how a mistake in a posted journal is corrected
cards.use: need to correct a wrong posted journal
not: removes the original journal from the ledger

cards.subject: PAYE rounding
says: rounds free pay up
rounds taxable pay down to whole pounds
rounds the tax itself down to the penny
cards.use: need the rule that rounds taxable pay down to whole pounds
not: rounds an exact half penny down

cards.subject: NI rounding
says: rounds to the nearest penny
sends an exact half penny down
is handled by NiCalculator::niRound()
cards.use: need the rule that sends an exact half penny down
not: truncates to whole pounds

cards.subject: Student loan rounding
says: truncates the threshold to whole pounds
truncates the deduction to whole pounds
drops pence rather than rounding to the nearest
cards.use: need the rule that truncates both threshold and deduction to whole pounds
not: rounds free pay up

cards.subject: VAT box rounding
says: rounds boxes 6 to 9 down to whole pounds
reports those four boxes in whole pounds rather than pence
cards.use: need the rule that gives whole pounds on four boxes of the return
not: rounds those boxes to the nearest penny

cards.subject: A single rounding rule
says: would put a penny wrong on roughly one payslip in two hundred
is deliberately not used for all taxes
ignores that HMRC sets a different rounding direction for each tax
cards.use: hear a proposal to use one rounding function for PAYE, NI and student loans
not: is recommended by the README to keep the code simple

cards.subject: An Open Banking feed
says: reads the bank directly for day-to-day use
needs no statement download to remember
writes to the same place as a CSV import
cards.use: want transactions to arrive without downloading statements
not: can move money between accounts

cards.subject: CSV import
says: covers a bank no provider supports, a closed account or older history
detects the statement columns automatically
is duplicate-safe
cards.use: need to load history older than the feed reaches
not: needs a provider redirect URI registered first

cards.subject: The BankConnector interface
says: lets three providers sit behind one contract
makes switching provider a config change rather than a rewrite
is what a fourth provider adapter must implement
cards.use: want to add another bank provider without touching the rest of the app
not: is a class that only GoCardless implements

cards.subject: GoCardless Bank Account Data
says: is the recommended starting provider
is documented as free to 50 accounts a month
shows the bank picker inside GG Money
is documented as allowing four transaction calls per account per day
cards.use: need the provider the documentation recommends starting with
not: needs a commercial agreement and a sales call

cards.subject: TrueLayer
says: needs an application review before live data
works in its sandbox immediately
shows its own bank-picker page
cards.use: need the provider that sends the user to its own hosted bank page and reviews applications for live data
not: shows its picker as a JavaScript widget

cards.subject: Plaid
says: has an adapter that negates its amounts because its sign is the opposite way round
shows its picker as a JavaScript widget
is documented as the provider that reports withdrawn transactions
is documented as having thinner UK coverage than the other two
cards.use: need the provider whose picker is a JavaScript widget
not: is free to 50 accounts a month

cards.subject: The banking callback URI
says: is https://ggmoney.gglink.co.uk/banking/callback
must be registered exactly with every bank provider
is the most common failure point when one character differs
cards.use: need the redirect value to register with a bank provider
not: is the same address used for the HMRC OAuth callback

cards.subject: Feed-to-account mapping
says: must be chosen before anything syncs
is never guessed because a wrong one puts a whole period in the wrong place
is refused when two feeds would write to one bank account
cards.use: connect a feed and see nothing sync
not: is filled in automatically from the first transaction

cards.subject: The first sync
says: asks for everything the bank allows
skips anything dated before the bank account's opening date
reports the rows it skipped
cards.use: need to know why old transactions did not appear after connecting
not: re-reads only the last week

cards.subject: A reconciled bank row
says: is never changed or deleted by a sync
may sit inside a filed VAT return
is listed on screen for handling by hand when a feed correction arrives
cards.use: see a feed correction arrive months after a VAT return was filed
not: is overwritten by the bank's latest figure on every sync

cards.subject: The transaction merge rule
says: requires the same account, date and amount
merges only when exactly one candidate exists
prefers a visible duplicate to a lost real transaction
cards.use: see three identical card payments of the same amount in one week
not: merges any two transactions with the same amount

cards.subject: Open Banking consent
says: lasts at most 90 days under UK rules
can run to 180 days for GoCardless agreements
triggers a warning from 14 days out
marks the connection expired after an authorisation error
cards.use: find that a feed has gone quiet after about three months
not: lasts a year and renews silently

cards.subject: MTD for VAT
says: is the route by which GG Money submits VAT returns
uses OAuth for authorisation
requires fraud prevention headers
cards.use: need to name the HMRC channel used for VAT returns
not: sends VAT returns as GovTalk XML to the Transaction Engine

cards.subject: Finalising a VAT return
says: locks the numbers
records exactly which transactions produced them
posts the journal
cards.use: want to freeze a return's figures without sending anything to HMRC
not: sends the return to HMRC

cards.subject: Submitting a VAT return
says: is a separate explicit act with its own declaration
cannot be undone because HMRC has no facility to withdraw a return
follows finalising
cards.use: need the step that actually sends the return to HMRC
not: can be withdrawn from HMRC later if a mistake is found

cards.subject: The VAT scheme setting
says: supports standard, cash accounting and flat rate
is covered by tests for all three schemes
was found by the 4 October audit to count VAT twice if switched between returns
cards.use: change a company's VAT scheme between two returns
not: also supports the annual accounting and margin schemes

cards.subject: vat_return_items
says: stores the individual transactions behind every box
lets any figure be traced to the journal that produced it
cards.use: need to trace a box figure back to its transactions
not: holds only the nine box totals

cards.subject: The fraud prevention header set
says: is sent on every call to every HMRC endpoint
is what HMRC checks before approving production credentials
includes the Cloudflare hop in Gov-Vendor-Forwarded
is validated on the sandbox against the Test Fraud Prevention Headers API
cards.use: hear that HMRC rejected an application over its headers
not: is sent only when a return is submitted

cards.subject: WEB_APP_VIA_SERVER
says: declares that a browser talks to our server and our server calls HMRC
omits Gov-Client-Local-IPs and Gov-Client-MAC-Addresses
is corrected, when the validator asks for desktop headers, by fixing the declared method
cards.use: need the connection method declared in the fraud prevention headers
not: is the method for desktop software that reads the local MAC address

cards.subject: Government Gateway sign-in
says: binds the token to the VAT enrolment behind the account used
must be that company's own login, once per company
would file against the wrong VRN if the wrong company's login is used
cards.use: are connecting the second company to HMRC
not: can use any director's personal login for both companies

cards.subject: The HMRC callback URI
says: is https://ggmoney.gglink.co.uk/settings/hmrc/callback
must match character for character with no trailing slash
is reported by HMRC only as an invalid request when it mismatches
cards.use: need the redirect value to register in the HMRC Developer Hub
not: is the same address used for the bank provider callback

cards.subject: Production approval from HMRC
says: was not granted as of the 5 October 2026 sources
is requested after sandbox testing, within two weeks of finishing it
is followed by a Production Approvals Checklist
cards.use: are asked whether GG Money may file real VAT returns yet
not: was granted when the sandbox tests passed

cards.subject: Payroll calculation
says: covers PAYE, National Insurance, student loans, pensions and statutory pay
still runs for a year whose rates are unverified
was checked against hand-computed figures
cards.use: want to compare payroll output with QuickBooks before filing
not: is blocked for any year not listed as verified

cards.subject: A payslip
says: shows its full workings
is produced by PayslipEngine
exists whether or not email is set up
cards.use: need the document an employee receives for a pay run
not: can only be created after an FPS is accepted

cards.subject: A tax year file
says: holds every rate, threshold and band for one year
keeps rates out of the calculation logic
lives at db/taxyears/<year>.php
cards.use: need to change a rate without editing the calculators
not: is generated from HMRC's website on each pay run

cards.subject: TAX_YEARS_VERIFIED
says: is the config list that makes a year fileable
stays empty until the rates have been checked against HMRC's tables
blocks RTI for any year not listed
cards.use: need to allow payroll filing for a checked tax year
not: is filled in automatically when a pay run is finalised

cards.subject: The needs_verification list
says: names every figure HMRC uprates each April
was copied forward from 2025/26 as placeholders
is to be treated as wrong until each figure is checked
cards.use: open the 2026-27 rates file and see figures that may be stale
not: lists the figures already confirmed with HMRC

cards.subject: RTI
says: goes to HMRC's Transaction Engine as GovTalk XML
does not use the MTD REST APIs
authenticates with Government Gateway credentials rather than OAuth
cards.use: need the channel used for payroll filings
not: authenticates with OAuth like VAT

cards.subject: An FPS
says: is the Full Payment Submission for a pay run
carries an IRmark
is built by FpsBuilder
is not called from any web screen according to the 5 October roadmap
cards.use: need the submission that reports each pay run to HMRC
not: is an annual summary sent once after the tax year ends

cards.subject: The IRmark
says: is attached to RTI submissions as an integrity check
is described in the deploy guide as correct and self-verifying
cannot confirm the element set, which only HMRC's validator can
cards.use: are asked what proves an RTI message was not altered
not: replaces the need to validate the XML against HMRC's schema

cards.subject: The RTI vendor ID
says: is a 4-digit ID
is issued by HMRC's Software Developer Support Team after the Test Service is passed
is stored as HMRC_RTI_VENDOR_ID
cards.use: need the identifier HMRC issues to software developers for RTI
not: is the employer's own Government Gateway sender ID

cards.subject: Employer RTI credentials
says: are the employer's own Government Gateway sender ID and password
are not issued to developers
need one gateway account carrying both companies' PAYE enrolments while the app stores a single sender ID
cards.use: hear that the second company's payroll is on a separate gateway account
not: are issued to the developer by the Software Developer Support Team

cards.subject: The compliance calendar
says: treats duties as first-class records
refreshes simply by opening the app
does not roll deadlines over weekends or bank holidays according to the roadmap
cards.use: want duties tracked in the app instead of in someone's head
not: is a static page edited by hand each year

cards.subject: The master task list
says: is the one file the calendar, reminder emails and written checklist are generated from
records each duty's frequency, due date, signer, consequence and governing rule
lives at db/compliance/tasks.php
cards.use: need the single source for what the app chases
not: is generated from the calendar page

cards.subject: The generated calendar document
says: is rendered by php bin/compliance.php --doc
is changed by editing the catalogue, not directly
states that dates are reminders, not advice
cards.use: need the written checklist that cannot drift from what the app chases
not: is the file the calendar reads its tasks from

cards.subject: Two-person sign-off
says: applies to filings
means a second person must approve before the task closes
makes the app refuse self-approval
cards.use: need to know who closes a VAT or payroll filing task
not: lets the person who did the filing mark it done

cards.subject: One-person sign-off
says: applies to routine housekeeping
needs only the person who did the work
cards.use: are asked who approves filing the day's receipts
not: requires a second person to review

cards.subject: An automatic check
says: runs and reports before a person approves
never signs anything off
cannot tell whether the figures were right
cards.use: want data-driven evidence before a person approves a task
not: approves a task once its test passes

cards.subject: VAT tasks
says: take HMRC's own obligation dates
cover preparing, checking and filing the return each VAT period
cards.use: need to know where VAT deadlines come from
not: follow the company's accounting reference date

cards.subject: Payroll tasks
says: follow your pay runs
include sending the Full Payment Submission for each pay run
cards.use: need to know where payroll deadlines come from
not: take HMRC's VAT obligation dates

cards.subject: Accounting-date tasks
says: come off the company's accounting reference date
include the year-end accounts and CT600 reminders
cards.use: need to know where year-end deadlines come from
not: follow the pay runs

cards.subject: Back-filling
says: is not done for routine daily work
avoids a list nobody can face
is why duties that do not apply are never raised
cards.use: hear that months of daily tasks should be created retroactively
not: is done for every daily task since the company was added

cards.subject: Brand performance
says: measures each brand against a plan
can cover a period from a day to all time
takes its actuals from the ledger
cards.use: want to see whether a trading line earns what the plan expected
not: is entered by hand each month as a spreadsheet

cards.subject: A brand
says: is a trading line inside a company
has a code such as moksy-studio
is managed under Settings, then Brands
cards.use: need the unit that costs and earnings are measured by
not: is a separate legal company

cards.subject: The master template
says: lists fixed and variable costs and earnings with how often each comes round
is adopted line by line by each brand
lets a variable cost be a percentage of earnings
cards.use: need the single list every brand plan starts from
not: holds each brand's actual figures

cards.subject: Plan history
says: ends the old line and starts a new one when an amount changes
keeps last quarter measured against last quarter's plan
cards.use: change a plan amount but want past periods judged by the old plan
not: overwrites the old amount in place

cards.subject: Unplanned postings
says: are postings no plan line claims
are never dropped
should be looked at first in a review
cards.use: see ledger postings that no plan line accounts for
not: are discarded from the performance figures

cards.subject: A brand review
says: freezes a period's figures with a fingerprint
needs someone else to approve it
is chased by a monthly compliance task
cards.use: need the sign-off record for a brand's month
not: is approved by the person who submitted it

cards.subject: A stale review
says: happens when the live fingerprint differs from the stored one
cannot be approved until it is submitted again
cards.use: find the ledger moved after a review was put up
not: can still be approved because the earlier figures were checked

cards.subject: The fingerprint
says: is a hash of every figure in the view
is stored with a review at submission
cards.use: need to detect that figures changed after submission
not: is a password that signs the review

cards.subject: The performance API
says: lets AI agents and services read brand figures and leave notes
lives under /api/v1
cannot post to the ledger, change the plan or sign anything off
cards.use: want an agent to review brand figures without letting it change anything
not: lets a service post journals to the ledger

cards.subject: A performance API token
says: is made under Settings, then API tokens
is shown once and stored only as a SHA-256
belongs to one company
cards.use: need credentials for one agent that can be revoked on its own
not: is stored in clear text so it can be shown again

cards.subject: The review scope
says: also allows posting notes on reviews
is separate from read, which is always granted
cards.use: need an agent to leave a note but not just read
not: lets the token approve a review

cards.subject: A review note
says: carries a verdict of comment, looks_right, concern or question
never changes a review's status
is shown under the token's name
cards.use: want an agent to flag a concern about a brand's month
not: approves the review when the verdict is looks_right

cards.subject: CSRF protection
says: issues a random token per session
rejects a POST whose token, sent as a form field or X-CSRF-Token header, does not match
compares tokens in constant time
matters because a forged POST could file a VAT return that cannot be withdrawn
cards.use: need to stop another site making a logged-in user submit a form
not: relies on the session cookie alone to prove intent

cards.subject: The session cookie
says: is HttpOnly
uses SameSite Lax because of the HMRC OAuth callback
has its session id regenerated
cards.use: need to explain why SameSite is not Strict
not: uses SameSite Strict

cards.subject: Password verification
says: uses password_verify
rehashes the password when needed
cards.use: need the function that checks a stored password hash
not: compares the stored password to the typed one as plain text

cards.subject: The tenant check
says: checks that account, contact and pension scheme ids belong to the company before use
was reported bypassed by forged ids in audit items 1 and 5
cards.use: need protection against a forged account or contact id from another company
not: trusts the ids in the submitted form

cards.subject: The .htaccess file
says: blocks the storage, src, db, views, bin, tests and docs directories
forces HTTPS
blocks the config files
cards.use: need to explain why src/Core/Db.php must return 403
not: lets directories be listed for debugging

cards.subject: AllowOverride All
says: is mandatory because every security rule lives in .htaccess
leaves config.local.php downloadable if it is off
would make database and HMRC secrets public if missing
cards.use: find config.local.php downloads in a browser test
not: is optional on the live server

cards.subject: Company roles
says: are owner, accountant or viewer
are carried on the user_companies link
are checked through Auth::requireRole
cards.use: need to know what controls what a person can do in a company
not: are set once per user for the whole installation

cards.subject: The audit_log table
says: is the table behind Auth::audit
has only five call sites writing to it according to the roadmap
swallows errors when a write fails
cards.use: need the record of who did what in the app
not: records every page view

cards.subject: The 5 October security gaps
says: include no MFA and no login throttling
include no password reset and no encryption at rest
include an unauthenticated deploy-check.php
cards.use: are asked what the audit said was missing from security and should be re-checked before relying on it
not: were all fixed by the same date

cards.subject: Running locally
says: starts by copying config.local.php.example to config.local.php
applies the schema with php bin/migrate.php
serves the app with php -S 127.0.0.1:8765 -t . bin/dev-server.php
cards.use: want to try the app on a laptop
not: needs Composer and npm install first

cards.subject: The setup page
says: is at /setup
creates the first user and both companies with a standard chart of accounts
disappears for good once an account exists
cards.use: are starting a new install with no account yet
not: stays open so more owners can register later

cards.subject: bin/deploy.sh
says: syntax-checks, tests, syncs, migrates and verifies
refuses to upload if a file fails to parse or a test fails
never touches config.local.php, storage or the database
cards.use: want to ship a new version and be stopped if anything is broken
not: uploads first and runs the tests afterwards

cards.subject: deploy-check.php
says: reports only and changes nothing
refuses to run over plain HTTP
asserts STRICT mode, InnoDB tables and applied migrations on MySQL
is run before and after uploading
cards.use: want a read-only verdict on whether the install would break or expose data
not: repairs problems it finds

cards.subject: migration-check.sh
says: applies the MySQL migrations to a scratch database
drops that scratch database again
is run before deploying a migration
cards.use: worry that a migration passes SQLite tests but MySQL may refuse it
not: runs the VAT test suite against production

cards.subject: APP_DEBUG
says: must be false in production
prints stack traces to the browser when on
cards.use: are asked which setting leaks stack traces
not: selects the sandbox or live hosts

cards.subject: MAIL_REDIRECT
says: sends every email to one address
adds a banner naming the intended recipient
keeps a test run from emailing a real employee
cards.use: need to test payslip email without reaching real people
not: is required for production sending

cards.subject: bin/backup.php
says: runs mysqldump with --single-transaction
keeps 30 gzipped daily copies
fails loudly if the dump is suspiciously small
cards.use: need the daily database backup
not: locks tables while it runs so it can block a pay run

cards.subject: Rolling back a bad code deploy
says: redeploys the previous commit
leaves the database alone
relies on journals being immutable so history survives
cards.use: need to undo a bad release
not: restores the latest database backup first

cards.subject: The QuickBooks cutover order
says: starts with opening balances and a full QuickBooks export
runs one VAT quarter in parallel, then two payroll months
cancels QuickBooks only after the parallel runs match
cards.use: are asked when QuickBooks can be cancelled
not: cancels QuickBooks once the README lists VAT as working

cards.subject: The cron schedule
says: runs bin/compliance.php, bin/alerts.php and bin/backup.php
runs compliance first so the calendar is current before the alert digest goes out
cards.use: need the scheduled jobs on the server
not: is the web request that opens the app

cards.subject: bank_api_log
says: records every provider request and response with tokens redacted
is the first place to look when a feed returns nothing
cards.use: find a feed that returns nothing and want the provider's actual answer
not: stores each user's banking password

cards.subject: hmrc_api_log
says: records every HMRC request and response with the header values sent
lets the team show HMRC exactly what went out
cards.use: are asked by HMRC what headers were sent
not: records bank provider calls

cards.subject: email_log
says: records every send, success or failure
omits the message body on purpose
shows who, what, when and what SendGrid said
cards.use: want proof of what the mailer sent
not: stores the full text of every payslip email

cards.subject: The in-house support model
says: has the developer as the user
has no external support desk
sends HMRC deprecation notices to the address that maintains the code
cards.use: are asked who supports GG Money
not: relies on a paid vendor helpdesk

cards.subject: A dead bank feed
says: is silent when it stops
is usually consent that has lapsed
is fixed by reconnecting, which loses no imported transactions
cards.use: find transactions have stopped arriving
not: is signalled by an email from the provider every time

cards.subject: A banking link left too long
says: produces the message that it could not be matched to a connection
is fixed by starting again
happens after more than 30 minutes
cards.use: see the could not be matched to a connection message
not: is fixed by reconnecting consent

cards.subject: The unit-test scripts
says: are plain PHP files run directly with php
run on SQLite by default
include vat_test.php, payroll_test.php and csrf_test.php
cards.use: want to run the checks that deploy.sh runs
not: are run through PHPUnit installed by Composer

cards.subject: The 4 October stress run
says: used 192,602 cases across 124 activities
produced 138 proposed issues
ran on throwaway databases only
did not cover MySQL, live channels or bank providers
cards.use: need the size and limits of the stress run
not: found no critical issues

cards.subject: Double-entry bookkeeping
says: records every transaction as equal debits and credits
keeps total debits equal to total credits in every posting
lets errors surface through a trial balance
cards.use: need the system where each posting touches at least two accounts
not: records each transaction once in a single account

cards.subject: A chart of accounts
says: is the structured list of accounts a ledger posts to
groups accounts into assets, liabilities, equity, income and expenses
gives each account a code
cards.use: need the list that decides where each posting can go
not: is the list of customers

cards.subject: A trial balance
says: lists every account balance at a date
has debit and credit totals that must agree
does not by itself prove each posting was correct
cards.use: want a check that a ledger is in balance
not: is a profit forecast

cards.subject: Accrual accounting
says: records income and costs when earned or incurred
separates profit from cash
needs debtors and creditors tracked
cards.use: want income and costs matched to the period they belong to
not: records income only when the money arrives

cards.subject: Cash accounting
says: records income and costs when money moves
ignores unpaid invoices and bills until they are settled
cards.use: want the simplest basis that follows the bank
not: records costs when they are incurred whether paid or not

cards.subject: Bank reconciliation
says: compares the ledger's bank account with the bank's own record
explains differences such as timing items
finds missing or duplicated bank lines
cards.use: need to show the ledger agrees with the bank
not: compares the ledger with the tax authority's records

cards.subject: A debtor
says: owes the business money for goods or services supplied
appears as a sales invoice not yet paid
cards.use: need the person who owes you money
not: is owed money by the business

cards.subject: A creditor
says: is owed money by the business
appears as a purchase bill not yet paid
cards.use: need the person you owe money to
not: owes the business money for goods supplied

cards.subject: A period close
says: stops postings into a finished period
makes a later correction a visible adjustment in a later period
cards.use: want figures for a finished month to stop moving
not: deletes the period's entries after reporting

cards.subject: A suspense account
says: holds items that cannot yet be classified
should be cleared back to zero
hides errors if allowed to grow
cards.use: find a posting that cannot be coded to a real account yet
not: is where profit is stored at year end

cards.subject: A minor-unit integer
says: stores money as a count of the smallest currency unit
avoids floating-point rounding error
needs the currency's exponent to display correctly
cards.use: need to hold £4.20 exactly
not: stores money as a binary fraction

cards.subject: Floating-point error
says: makes 0.1 plus 0.2 differ from 0.3 in binary arithmetic
is why money should not be stored as floats
can accumulate across many additions
cards.use: hear that totals drift by a fraction of a penny
not: happens only with very large amounts

cards.subject: An idempotency key
says: lets a retried request be recognised as the same request
prevents a repeated payment call from charging twice
is supplied by the caller and stored with the result
cards.use: need a timed-out payment call to be retried safely
not: makes each retry create a new payment

cards.subject: A database transaction
says: makes a group of writes succeed or fail together
rolls back on error
needs a storage engine that supports it, such as InnoDB
cards.use: need a journal's debit and credit lines to be written together or not at all
not: commits each statement independently as it runs

cards.subject: OAuth 2.0 authorization code grant
says: sends the user to the provider to sign in and consent
returns a code to a registered redirect URI
exchanges the code for tokens on the server
cards.use: need a user to authorise access without sharing a password
not: asks the user to type the provider password into the app

cards.subject: A least-privilege scope
says: limits a token to what the integration needs
is why a bank connection asks only for read access
cards.use: want a leaked token to be able to do as little as possible
not: grants the token full account rights

cards.subject: Exponential backoff
says: spaces out retries with growing delays
helps when a provider answers with a rate limit
cards.use: face a provider rate-limit response
not: retries immediately in a tight loop

cards.subject: A webhook signature
says: lets the receiver verify the sender with a shared secret
guards against forged callbacks
is checked before acting on the payload
cards.use: receive a callback that claims to come from a provider
not: is optional once the endpoint URL is kept secret

cards.subject: An insecure direct object reference
says: lets a user reach another user's record by changing an id
is prevented by checking ownership on the server for every request
cards.use: see a forged account id in a request return another company's data
not: is prevented by hiding the id in a form field

cards.subject: Token hashing
says: stores only a one-way hash of a token
means a database leak does not reveal usable tokens
requires showing the token once at creation
cards.use: need to store API tokens so a database leak is not enough to use them
not: stores the token so it can be shown again

cards.subject: Know your customer
says: verifies who a customer is before service
is a core part of onboarding in regulated finance
cards.use: need to confirm identity before opening an account
not: checks a customer's credit score only

cards.subject: Anti-money-laundering monitoring
says: watches transactions for suspicious patterns
leads to reports to authorities when suspicion arises
cards.use: spot payments that look structured to avoid detection
not: is limited to onboarding checks

cards.subject: PCI DSS
says: is the security standard for handling payment card data
applies to anyone who stores, processes or transmits card data
cards.use: are asked which standard governs card data
not: is the standard for tax-return software recognition

cards.subject: Open Banking
says: lets customers share account data with authorised third parties
works through regulated APIs and customer consent
cards.use: need the regime behind a read-only bank feed
not: lets any app read an account with only the account number

cards.subject: Segregation of duties
says: splits a task so one person cannot both do and approve it
reduces the risk of fraud and error
is implemented as a four-eyes check
cards.use: want to stop a single person completing and approving a filing
not: lets the preparer also approve if they are senior

cards.subject: An audit trail
says: records who did what and when
should itself resist tampering
is expected by auditors and regulators
cards.use: need evidence of who changed a financial record
not: may be edited later to fix typing mistakes

cards.subject: Data minimisation
says: keeps only the personal data needed for a purpose
is a GDPR principle
is practised by not storing message bodies in an email log
cards.use: are asked why a debug table should not copy salaries
not: says to keep all data in case it is useful later

cards.subject: Record retention
says: requires financial records to be kept for a legally set period
is six years for the records this app is built around, per the deploy guide
cards.use: need to know why backups must be kept off the server and for years
not: lets records be purged after one year

cards.subject: Strong customer authentication
says: requires two independent factors for many online payments and account access
is a feature of the PSD2 rules
cards.use: hear that a payment needs a second independent factor
not: is satisfied by a single password

cards.subject: Making Tax Digital
says: requires digital record keeping and software-based filing
is the regime that VAT returns follow in GG Money
cards.use: need the UK programme behind digital VAT filing
not: allows returns to be filed by paper only

qa.q: Which two companies is GG Money built for?
qa.right: Gurugraphics Limited and Moksy Limited
wrong: Moksy Limited and any customer company that signs up
Gurugraphics Limited only, with Moksy staying on QuickBooks
Every limited company registered at the same address
qa.why: The README says it is built for those two companies and is not sold.

qa.q: Which database does the live GG Money server use?
qa.right: MySQL 8, because the server already had it and a PHP 8.1 driver
wrong: SQLite, the same as local development
qa.why: SQLite is the default for local development and tests; the live server uses MySQL.

qa.q: What does it mean that the app has no Composer or npm dependency?
qa.right: The whole application is plain PHP 8.1 or later plus a database
wrong: It loads its libraries from a CDN at run time
It vendors a single framework in the repository
It uses Composer only on the live server
qa.why: The README states no third-party packages at all.

qa.q: What is the stated status of Corporation Tax, the CT600 and iXBRL accounts?
qa.right: Not built and left to a later phase
wrong: Built and filed through the live install
qa.why: The README marks them Phase 3, not built.

qa.q: What does it mean that the live install is in sandbox mode?
qa.right: Nothing has yet been filed for real through it
wrong: Only VAT is filed for real
Only payroll is filed for real
Real filings happen but are marked as tests
qa.why: Production approval from HMRC had not been granted and APP_ENV stays sandbox until a parallel run matches.

qa.q: How does GG Money store the amount £4,800.00?
qa.right: As the integer 480000 pence
qa.why: Every monetary value is an integer number of pence; floats are banned.

qa.q: How is a 20 percent rate stored?
qa.right: As 2000 basis points
qa.why: Percentages are basis points, so 20 percent is 2000.

qa.q: A new local install shows no users. Where should the first account be created?
qa.right: At /setup, which disappears once an account exists
wrong: At /register, which stays open for more owners
By inserting a row into users with SQL
At /admin/users after logging in as admin
qa.why: The setup page creates the first user and both companies, then goes away.

qa.q: A posted journal has the wrong amount. What is the correct fix?
qa.right: Post a reversal and then the correct journal
wrong: Edit the journal line in place
Delete the journal and re-enter it
Update the amount directly in the database
qa.why: Posted journals are never edited or deleted; a correction is a reversal so both error and fix stay visible.

qa.q: Who must approve a filing task in the compliance calendar?
qa.right: A second person, because the app refuses self-approval
wrong: The person who did the filing
Nobody, the automatic check approves it
qa.why: Filings need a second person; routine tasks need one.

qa.q: What can an automatic compliance check do?
qa.right: Report on the data before a person approves, but never sign off
wrong: Sign off the task when the data looks right
Approve filings for the second person
Delete tasks that do not apply
qa.why: A check cannot tell whether the figures were right.

qa.q: Why is the schema kept separately for SQLite and MySQL instead of translated at run time?
qa.right: A silent translation bug in a finance app is worse than some duplication
wrong: MySQL cannot run the SQLite SQL at all
Translation is too slow for payroll runs
The two databases are never used together
qa.why: The README states this reason.

qa.q: How does GG Money round PAYE tax?
qa.right: Down to the penny, after taxable pay is rounded down to whole pounds
wrong: To the nearest penny with halves going up
Up to the next whole pound
qa.why: PAYE: free pay up, taxable pay down to pounds, tax down to the penny.

qa.q: An employee's NI works out at exactly half a penny. What does the NI rule do?
qa.right: Rounds down
wrong: Rounds to the nearest even penny
qa.why: NI rounds to the nearest penny with an exact half going down.

qa.q: How are VAT boxes 6 to 9 reported?
qa.right: In whole pounds, rounded down
qa.why: VAT boxes 6 to 9 are whole pounds, rounded down.

qa.q: A developer proposes one rounding function for PAYE, NI and student loans. What does the README say?
qa.right: It would put a penny wrong on roughly one payslip in two hundred
wrong: It is preferred to reduce code
It is fine because HMRC allows any rounding
It is fine for NI but not student loans
qa.why: HMRC sets a different rule for each tax.

qa.q: Why does the MySQL schema use BIGINT for money columns?
qa.right: INT overflows at 21.5 million pounds when counting pence
wrong: BIGINT is required by STRICT mode
qa.why: The README gives this reason.

qa.q: After connecting a bank, nothing syncs. What is the most likely cause?
qa.right: The feed has not been pointed at one of your bank accounts
wrong: The cron job for alerts is missing
The VAT scheme is set to cash accounting
qa.why: Nothing syncs until each feed is mapped, and the mapping is never guessed.

qa.q: A feed stops delivering after about three months and sync returns 401 or 403. What is the first thing to do?
qa.right: Reconnect, because consent has expired
wrong: Delete the bank account and re-import the CSV history
qa.why: UK Open Banking consent lasts at most 90 days; reconnecting loses nothing.

qa.q: A bank corrects an amount on a row you have already reconciled. What does the sync do?
qa.right: Leaves it alone and lists it on screen for you to handle by hand
wrong: Overwrites it with the bank's figure
Deletes the row and re-imports it
Merges it into a similar row
qa.why: The row may be inside a filed VAT return.

qa.q: Three identical £4.20 payments arrive in one week from a feed and a CSV. What does the merge rule do?
qa.right: Merges only where account, date and amount match with exactly one candidate
wrong: Merges every pair with the same amount
Always keeps the CSV row and deletes the feed rows
qa.why: A visible duplicate can be deleted; merging two real transactions loses one.

qa.q: What is the exact bank callback address to register with every provider?
qa.right: https://ggmoney.gglink.co.uk/banking/callback
qa.why: HMRC uses a different callback.

qa.q: In what order does a VAT return move through its states?
qa.right: Draft, finalised, submitted
qa.why: Finalising locks the numbers; submitting is a separate act.

qa.q: Why are finalising and submitting separate acts?
qa.right: HMRC has no facility to withdraw a submitted return
wrong: HMRC requires two weeks between them
qa.why: Submitting has its own declaration.

qa.q: A user connects Gurugraphics but signs in with Moksy's Government Gateway account. What happens?
qa.right: The token binds to Moksy's VAT enrolment, so figures would be filed against the wrong VRN
wrong: HMRC rejects it before saving any token
The app silently swaps to the correct company
Nothing, the token works for both companies
qa.why: The token binds to whichever enrolment sits behind the login.

qa.q: Which command creates a sandbox VAT test business?
qa.right: php8.1 bin/hmrc-test-user.php
qa.why: It prints a gateway ID, password and VRN once.

qa.q: When can payroll for a tax year be filed through RTI?
qa.right: Once the year is listed in TAX_YEARS_VERIFIED after checking its rates
wrong: As soon as the pay run is finalised
When the year's rates file exists
qa.why: Payroll calculates regardless but RTI is blocked until verified.

qa.q: Which statement about RTI is true?
qa.right: It goes to the Transaction Engine as GovTalk XML using Government Gateway credentials
wrong: It uses the MTD REST API with OAuth
It uses SendGrid as its transport
It is filed through the bank provider
qa.why: RTI does not use the MTD REST APIs.

qa.q: How is a performance API token stored?
qa.right: Only a SHA-256 of it is stored, and the token is shown once
wrong: In clear text so it can be re-shown
qa.why: This is a token-hashing design.

qa.q: An AI agent with the review scope finds a concern in a brand review. What can it do?
qa.right: Post a note with a verdict and flags, without changing the review's status
qa.why: Notes advise; only a person approves.

qa.q: What makes a brand review stale?
qa.right: The live fingerprint differs from the one stored at submission
qa.why: A stale review has to be put up again.

qa.q: You are about to deploy a change that adds a migration. What should you run first?
qa.right: ./bin/migration-check.sh
qa.why: Tests run on SQLite, and MySQL can still refuse a migration.

qa.q: What does bin/deploy.sh never touch?
qa.right: config.local.php, storage and the database
qa.why: It still applies migrations as part of the deploy.

qa.q: A bad release must be undone. What is the rollback?
qa.right: Redeploy the previous commit and leave the database alone
wrong: Edit the journals back by hand
qa.why: Code and data are separate, and posted journals are immutable.

qa.q: A sandbox install has no MAIL_REDIRECT set. What happens to payslip emails?
qa.right: Nothing is sent
wrong: They go to the real employees
They go to the owner automatically
qa.why: A sandbox install must not email real employees their salaries.

qa.q: When MAIL_REDIRECT is set, where does an email go?
qa.right: To that one address with a banner naming the intended recipient
wrong: To both the recipient and that address
To the original recipient with a banner
qa.why: You receive exactly what the recipient would have.

qa.q: The README lists RTI FPS generation as working but the 5 October roadmap disagrees. Which reading matches the roadmap?
qa.right: The FPS builder exists but nothing in the web layer calls it, and there is no EPS builder
wrong: The FPS is filed daily and the EPS is built
Both builders are wired and tested
qa.why: Several items marked working still need credentials, wiring or fixes.

qa.q: A colleague says QuickBooks can be cancelled because the README lists VAT as working. What do the sources say?
qa.right: Wait until one VAT quarter matches to the penny and two payroll months match exactly in parallel
wrong: Cancel once the sandbox test passes
Cancel once the first return is filed
Cancel once the backup cron is running
qa.why: The parallel run earns the cutover.

qa.q: What is the 5 October 2026 audit's description of OAuth token storage, and how should it be treated?
qa.right: Stored and logged in clear text (item 83); re-check before relying on it
qa.why: A draft production checklist says tokens are never logged; the audit reports otherwise.

qa.q: Cloudflare is set to Flexible for the GG Money hostname. What is the risk?
qa.right: HMRC tokens would travel in the clear between Cloudflare and the origin
wrong: Browsers will not load the site
qa.why: Full (strict) is required.

qa.q: A test shows https://ggmoney.gglink.co.uk/config.local.php downloads. What is most likely wrong?
qa.right: AllowOverride is off, so .htaccess is ignored and the secrets are public
qa.why: Fix before anything else.

qa.q: Why does CSRF protection matter especially in GG Money?
qa.right: A forged POST could file a VAT return that cannot be withdrawn
qa.why: The code comment says exactly this.

qa.q: Why are session cookies SameSite Lax rather than Strict?
qa.right: The HMRC OAuth callback needs the cookie sent on the redirect back
wrong: Strict is not supported by PHP
qa.why: The callback is a cross-site top-level navigation.

qa.q: A sync finds the bank has withdrawn a transaction you have not reconciled. What happens?
qa.right: It is deleted
wrong: It is kept and flagged for the owner
It is reversed with a journal
qa.why: A withdrawn unreconciled transaction is deleted; reconciled ones are left.

qa.q: A new provider returns debits as positive amounts. What must its adapter do?
qa.right: Negate them so amountPence is positive for money in
wrong: Leave them, the importer fixes the sign
qa.why: Plaid is the opposite way round and negates; a test pins this.

qa.q: A month-end agent reads a submitted review. What is the right first step?
qa.right: Skip it if stale, then read the unplanned postings first
qa.why: The API guide's outline.

qa.q: A manager says the 4 October stress run proves the system on MySQL. Why is that wrong?
qa.right: It ran on SQLite only and did not cover MySQL, live channels or bank providers
wrong: It covered MySQL but not SQLite
qa.why: The audit says nothing had been fixed.

qa.q: Which items of the 4 October audit did the 5 October roadmap say were fixed?
qa.why: Tests had not been run.

qa.q: An engineer wants to make a feed sync idempotent by deleting and re-importing the last month. Why is this unsafe?
qa.right: It could alter reconciled rows that sit inside a filed VAT return
wrong: It would exceed the rate limit only
It breaks the Y-m-d date format
qa.why: Reconciled rows are never changed.

qa.q: Moksy's PAYE enrolment sits on a different gateway account from Gurugraphics. What limits filing for the second company?
qa.right: The app stores one RTI sender ID, so storage would need to become per-company
wrong: HMRC allows only one company per vendor ID
qa.why: Noted in the RUNBOOK.

qa.q: Why should money not be stored as floating point?
qa.right: Binary floats cannot represent many decimal fractions exactly
wrong: Floats are not supported in MySQL
qa.why: 0.1 plus 0.2 is the classic example.

qa.q: A client retries a payment request after a timeout. How do you avoid charging twice?
qa.right: Send an idempotency key so the retry is recognised as the same request
qa.why: The server stores the result against the key.

qa.q: What does double-entry bookkeeping guarantee in a posting?
qa.right: Total debits equal total credits
wrong: Every posting has a single line
Every posting affects the bank account
qa.why: It keeps the books in balance.

qa.q: A suspense account balance keeps growing. What should happen?
qa.right: Investigate and clear the items to real accounts
wrong: Leave it, it will net off
Write it off at year end
qa.why: Suspense hides errors.

qa.q: What does this cron line do?
qa.right: Generates missing compliance tasks, runs the automatic checks and prints what is overdue, before the alert digest
wrong: Emails each owner the deadline digest
qa.why: bin/compliance.php files nothing and emails nobody.

qa.q: What does this config line mean for a 2026-27 pay run?
qa.right: Payroll calculates for 2026-27 but RTI is blocked, because only 2025-26 is verified
wrong: RTI is allowed for 2026-27 using placeholder rates
qa.why: A year is fileable only once it is listed in TAX_YEARS_VERIFIED.

qa.q: What does this query show?
qa.code: SELECT created_at, to_email, subject, status, error FROM email_log ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 20;
qa.right: The twenty most recent email sends with status and any error, but not message bodies
wrong: The full text of the latest payslip emails
qa.why: email_log omits the body deliberately.

qa.q: What does this request return?
qa.right: Performance figures for the moksy-studio brand for the month containing 1 August 2026
wrong: A new review for the brand
qa.why: scope, period and date select the view.

qa.q: What does this POST do to the review?
qa.code:
POST /api/v1/reviews/12/notes
{"verdict":"concern","body":"Card fees are 5.1% of sales against a plan of 2.9%.","flags":["7900","cost.payment_fees"]}
qa.right: Adds a concern note with flags, without changing the review's status
wrong: Edits the plan line for account 7900
qa.why: It needs the review scope and notes only advise.

qa.q: What does this command do?
qa.right: Previews what a deploy would change without uploading
wrong: Deploys and then runs the tests
qa.why: The real deploy omits --dry-run.
